summary: Example task replaces WeOS 4 config from a local file with cli_config using replace yes, diff_match exact and diff_replace config.
questions: How do I push a full config file to a WeOS 4 device?
How do I replace the whole config with cli_config?

answer_card.title: Replace WeOS 4 config from a file
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Replace configuration with file on ansible host (WeOS 4)
  ansible.netcommon.cli_config:
    config: "{{ lookup('file', 'westermo.conf') }}"
    replace: "yes"
    diff_match: exact
    diff_replace: config
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.weos4'
```
